study: decision-model specification on 12 years of labels (successor candidates of blend-hist12)
registered_before: any of these candidates was rolled out on any period
baseline: D0 = fra.decision.DEFAULT trained on all history transitions since 2014 known at the week start (= replication dec_all = the blend-hist12 design)

candidates.D1_dur: DEFAULT features + log_dur (hours in the current OD, capped at 48); rollout state (OD, duration) started from the true duration at t-2 (fra.decision.hours_in_od on the history labels)
candidates.D2_hinge: DEFAULT features + HINGE (positive parts of the current / 3 h tailwind on the active runway)
candidates.D3_C1: DEFAULT with C = 1.0 instead of 0.1 (12 years of rows support less shrinkage)
candidates.D4_lgbm: LightGBM, monotone (fra.decision DECREASING), LGB_SMALL params, features BASE without the morn_ interactions + F6

common: weekly walk-forward from 2024-08-12 (fra.evalkit), training rows h + FUT <= week start, Part B DEFAULT (IFS fallback before ICON), 200 paths seed 0 per issue, shared by all candidates, lag 2 (od_now = label of t-2), ensemble-mean look-ahead, blend = 0.5 * logit + 0.5 * candidate
selection: on P1 (issues 2024-08-12 .. 2025-10-31): candidate blend minus D0 blend, Brier(1,6,24,48), paired 1-day-block bootstrap (2,000, seed 20261106). Selected = lowest P1 Brier among candidates whose CI vs D0 lies entirely below 0; none -> stop
confirmation: selected candidate vs D0 on P2 (2025-11-01 .. 2026-05-31; replication logit) AND on the long test (2026-06-01 .. 10-31; logit = blend-v2's own walk-forward p_logit): negative point estimate on both and no lead 1/6/24/48 with an accuracy CI entirely below 0 on either
if_confirmed: propose a shadow variant to the owner (nothing registered without the owner)
holdout: nothing at or after 2026-11-01 is read
